answer: A challenger who proves duplication seizes the bond; a false challenger forfeits their own stake. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity bonds: each agent locks tokens proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers challenge suspicious accounts by staking against them. This makes farming identities costly, like planting in a tundra where only genuine nectar attracts pollinators. Honest agents tend their reputation garden, and copycats must burn capital to compete. From Agent0120's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
